en.title: Completed and ongoing action: aspect
en.summary: Aspect shows whether an action is seen as finished, in progress or as a result.

paragraphs: Aspect shows how an action is seen: as a whole, as in progress or as completed. English shows it with the continuous and perfect forms.
English combines tense and aspect. The simple form presents a whole action, the continuous looks inside it, and the perfect looks back at it from a later point.
